run_inverse_dynamics: run inverse dynamics on a MuJoCo model to compute generalized forces from accelerations
convert_discrete_acceleration: convert discrete-time joint acceleration to continuous-time acceleration for Euler and ImplicitFast integrators
solve_inverse_constraints: solve inverse constraint forces for a MuJoCo model with active constraints
compute_euler_damping_force: compute Euler damping force contribution to generalized forces from joint velocity and acceleration
calculate_inverse_force: calculate inverse force as bias plus mass-acceleration minus passive and constraint forces
